designBasis.traffic: WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation 4.33 and 16.6: provide safe movement and pedestrian separation where practicable; otherwise effective precautions. Obstructed views require effective controls.
designBasis.structure: WorkSafeBC 4.2 and 4.3; applicable BC Building Code and local requirements. Municipality, site loads, seismic design, foundations and impact protection remain to be established. Vancouver has its own building by-law.
designBasis.piping: Assess pressure piping under Technical Safety BC requirements, CSA B51 and the applicable piping code, including ASME B31.3 where applicable. Registration and exemptions require a line-specific assessment.
designBasis.vehicle: WorkSafeBC 16.43: applicable lift-truck standard and operator training requirements. Confirm the actual truck, attachments, load and manufacturer manoeuvring data.
designBasis.assumptions: The 3.5 m front-axle turning radius and 0.5 m allowances are model planning assumptions, not statutory minimum clearances. Route screening does not qualify lifting, reversing, braking or operating speed.

geometricFindings.reason: New containment component enters protected access volume

geometryReview.scope: Continuous raised floor boundaries, support-island / inlet exclusion, calculated storage, segregated identities, descending paths, inlet elevations, new spill-pipe separation and avoidance of retention foundations, routine reach and new components against pedestrian / stair-access reservations. Dynamic spill capture, existing buried services / foundation depths and civil design remain unqualified.

entrancePortals.qualification: HOLD: combined pipe reactions, lateral stability, guide/anchor loads, connection strength and foundations; entrance portal span, deflection and lateral/seismic load paths require calculation before construction

structuralAttachments.method: Declared mounting points checked against part geometry and assembled transforms, with graph reachability to foundations. Structural strength is not calculated.
